days.title: 砂丘 – 妖精の渓流
days.morning: Jeep to watch sunrise over the White Dunes.
days.afternoon: Walk the Fairy Stream and visit Mui Ne fishing village.
days.evening: Sunset at the Flying Dunes and seaside seafood.

days.title: ビーチとスポーツ
days.morning: Learn kitesurfing or swim at your resort.
days.afternoon: Poshanu Cham towers and the wine castle.

days.title: ケーガー岬
days.morning: Ke Ga lighthouse – one of Vietnam's oldest lighthouses.
days.afternoon: Swim at Tien Thanh beach and explore Ong Dia rocks.
days.evening: Back in Phan Thiet for lẩu thả hotpot.

days.title: ホンロム – ヌクマム村
days.morning: Swim at Hon Rom and paddleboard in the morning.
days.afternoon: Phan Thiet fish sauce village and local specialties.
days.evening: Grilled seafood at Doi Duong beach.

days.title: タクー山
days.morning: Cable car up Ta Cu mountain to Southeast Asia's largest reclining Buddha.
days.afternoon: Ke Ga beach and the Pink Dunes.
days.evening: Return to Saigon or stay another night at the resort.
